messages:
maya: quick async standup — audits / kms / iam
maya: yesterday: finished the S3 bucket audit & flagged 3 buckets with public read ACLs, opened SEC-324 for remediation
maya: blocker: waiting on infra to approve change window for the kms rotation (workspace has 2x critical services)
maya: today: coordinate rotation window, follow up on SEC-324, review @ryan's PR for least-privilege IAM change (:eyes:)

ryan: thanks — i'll review SEC-324 details now. i pushed a draft PR: #1127
ryan: note: the IAM change removes "s3:*" broad grants from the pipeline role and adds specific ops:ListObjects/PutObject
ryan: question for @omar — does removing s3:ListBucket break any dashboard jobs? i can add a fallback if so

omar: quick check — dashboard jobs use ListBucket only in the nightly export job, we can grant a scoped ListBucket on that prefix instead
omar: no objections to rotation window, prefer Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC to avoid traffic spikes

alix: PR #1127 comments left, minor nits. also ran the post-audit scan on staging, found 1 infra role with overdue console access sessions — will file SEC-326
alix: FYI i updated the audit doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/sec/audits/2026-q1 (added remediation steps + rehearsal checklist)

chris: re: KMS rotation — security-bot reported earlier that the rotation script succeeded in staging
chris: snippet we ran locally:
```
./kms-rotate --key-id=rw-main --dry-run
# verify: curl -s http://orchestrator/status | jq .kms_status
```
chris: need an ops ack before we run prod. tagging @deploy-bot to schedule maintenance window

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance job created: MNT-778, tentative window Tue 2026-03-24 03:00–04:00 UTC. react with :thumbsup: to approve or comment to reschedule.

jen: approve from compliance side — Tue morning UTC looks good. Please include rollback steps in the runbook (we had an incident last year where a mismatched key caused 15m outage)
jen: proposed rollback snippet:
```
# rollback to previous key
kms-restore --key-id=rw-main --version=prev
service restart --group=llm-proxy
```

ryan: noted, i'll add rollback to PR and runbook. should i also add a pre-check job to assert all services can access test-encrypted blobs? (makes sense to me)

maya: yes please add pre-check.
maya: action items summary: ryans PR #1127 (iam least-priv), alix files SEC-326, chris to run staging rotate checklist again, omar confirm dashboard prefix policy, jen will sign off compliance docs, deploy-bot to lock window once we have a thumbs up

maya: any other blockers? otherwise i'll mark this thread in the radar and ping infra next hour

omar: no other blockers from infra side, will verify the prefix scoping by EOD

ryan: i can be on-call for the window if needed, ping me

security-bot: reminder: quarterly audit due in 7 days — open items: SEC-321, SEC-322, SEC-324, SEC-326

maya: thanks all :thumbsup: — closing async checkin, will post follow-up notes after rotation planning meeting.
